title: Split-Fill Dispensing of New Therapies (Specialty Pharmacy Program)
content:
**Rule.** Where a Specialty Pharmacy Program tier runs the split-fill program, a drug on the split-fill list is dispensed as partial fills during the first split-fill months of a new therapy. Each partial fill is of the tier's split-fill days supply. A pharmacist check-in comes before each partial fill. After that period, or where the tier does not run the split-fill program, the drug is dispensed as full fills.

A member who continues the same drug from another pharmacy is not starting a new therapy, and gets full fills.

## Records consulted

The partial fills shipped on the enrollment from its activation date through today are the record of how many split fills the therapy has received.

## Branches

| Split-fill program on the tier | Drug on the split-fill list | New therapy | Within the first split-fill months | Dispensed as |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Runs | Yes | Yes | Yes | Partial fills of the split-fill days supply, each preceded by a pharmacist check-in |
| Runs | Yes | Yes | No, the period is over | Full fills |
| Runs | Yes | No, continuing the drug from another pharmacy | either | Full fills |
| Does not run | any | any | any | Full fills |

## Cases (assumed facts)

- *A member starts Ibrance for the first time on a tier whose split-fill program runs.* The first fills of the therapy within the split-fill months are partial fills, and a pharmacist check-in precedes each one.
- *A member has taken Ibrance for a year at another specialty pharmacy and moves to Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy.* This is not a new therapy, so the member gets full fills.
